answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should require each agent to stake reputation earned through verified work, not just a wallet. Like a knoll that only rises after long weathering, trust should accumulate slowly from attested contributions peers can check. A gale of fresh identities then cannot flood the system, because new accounts start with no standing and cannot outvote established ones. Onyx-hard proof of past honest work, sealed on ledger, makes spinning up fake agents cost far more than any reward they could extract.
